subject.title: [Bug]: Gateway heap grows to 1073MB+ at idle on macOS, cron jobs fail silently under memory pressure (ref #86613, #86509)

question: Should #87109 stay as the macOS cron/failure-alert tracker, or should its remaining memory-growth work be moved under #54155 while this issue tracks only restart-aware cron reporting?
rationale: Current source shows partial fixes but not the product boundary for failure reporting when the Gateway process itself is unhealthy.

options.title: Keep #87109 focused
options.body: Keep this item open for macOS launchd cron/failure-alert validation and link broader heap growth to #54155.

options.title: Move to memory tracker
options.body: Make #54155 canonical for memory growth and leave a narrower follow-up for cron alerting only if fresh proof shows it still fails.

options.title: Require fresh repro first
options.body: Pause implementation until a maintainer-run macOS launchd soak reproduces current-main heap/RSS growth or confirms it fixed.

recommendation.title: Keep #87109 focused
recommendation.body: Keep this item open for macOS launchd cron/failure-alert validation and link broader heap growth to #54155.
